name: Reading Strategies [Advanced]
description: This course introduces students to reading as a fundamental skill for language comprehension. It focuses on reading for understanding, helping students grasp the author’s arguments, positions, postulations, and the evidence used to support them. Students will engage in reading for enquiry, developing the ability to analyze and question texts critically. Students will practice making critical interventions, using reading as a tool to improve their own writing, comprehension, enhance clarity, and develop stronger analytical and argumentative skills in academic and creative contexts.
